package card_run

import (
	"example.com/card-rpg-practice/game/cardrpg"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest/entitytimer"
	"time"
)

const TimerTurn int32 = 1

func (component *TimerComponent) registerTimerHandlers(handlers *entitytimer.Handlers) {
	handlers.Register(TimerTurn, func(f entitytimer.Fire) time.Duration {
		d := component.owner.Dao()
		// ID 与下一命令序号都必须属于本回合；旧断线 / 旧定时器不会推进新回合。
		if d.GetTurnTimer() != f.ID {
			return 0
		}
		b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(d.GetState())
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if b.State.Status != "running" || int64(b.NextSeq()) != f.Param1 || b.State.Deadline != f.Deadline.UnixMilli() {
			panic(cardrpg.ErrRule)
		}
		if err := b.Apply(cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: b.NextSeq(), Kind: "timeout"}, f.Now.UnixMilli()); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		d.SetState(b.Encode())
		d.SetTurnTimer(0)
		// 离线过期只补一次，从本次实际触发时间开始下一回合，遵循 entitytimer 不追帧契约。
		if b.State.Status == "running" {
			id := component.NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(b.State.Deadline), TimerTurn, int64(b.NextSeq()), 0, nil)
			if id == 0 {
				panic(cardrpg.ErrRule)
			}
			d.SetTurnTimer(id)
		}
		return 0
	})
}
